card.name: Space before a paroxetine dose number
card.fires_on: The space token right before a numeric dose (like 20, 40, 10 or 60 mg/day) in paroxetine dosing sentences. It follows phrases such as "dosage is", "started on" or "should not exceed".

modes.label: Recommended dose is
modes.description: Space after a phrase stating the recommended or target dose, just before the number.
modes.example: The recommended starting dosage and the established effective dosage is<< >>20 mg

modes.label: Started on / above
modes.description: Space after "started on" or "doses above" or "exceed", just before a mg/day amount.
modes.example: Patients should be started on<< >>10 mg/day. Dose changes

card.writes: It pushes toward digits and away from words like derivative, stimulation and pain, so a number comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right before a paroxetine dose amount is written out.
